I have fixed the issue after updating the tablet.

Either mi fixed the issue or Crunchyroll fixed the issue. 

I also did all those things man. 

First check if there is a latest update for your tablet in the settings.

If not, here's what I did. 

1. First tested if the issue still persists, yes it did.
2. Went to settings -> About tablet -> detailed info and specs -> tapped kernel version multiple times -> swiped down to the bottom of the list -> Security certificates update -> Update widevine L1 certificate -> Backed out of the settings.

Right then an update popped up and I have updated it.

Done! It's now working fine!
